bit.screening_note: D/E ceiling over rank-mass-preserving repackings with fractional counts at ranks up to the halving guard; screening only, not a realizability bound

complex.screening_note: D/E ceiling over rank-mass-preserving repackings with fractional counts at ranks up to the halving guard; screening only, not a realizability bound

lemma: For f(a) = (1/(mW)) sum_r n_r r (m/r)^a + c_s m^a with 0 < r < m, W >= 1 and c_s >= 0, f is convex and f(0) = 1 - D_eff/(mW) with D_eff > 0. The tangent at a = 0 meets 1 at D_eff/E_eff, so the exact root satisfies a* < D_eff/E_eff strictly. For c_s = 0 this is the autoresearch.md section-2 diagnostic a < D/E.
limitations: The paid profiles are taken from the published ledgers (ASSEMBLY.json complex_profile; EXPECTED.json nine.profile); this package does not rebuild either word from its original operations.
The conservative (surcharge-on-complex) endpoints of ASSEMBLY.json are not rechecked here.
D/E is a per-histogram ceiling; an upper bound over all repackings needs the coverage-law argument, see https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1240 for the complex local word.

method.arithmetic: exact fractions throughout; enclosures from explicit inequalities only; no floating point
method.exp: Taylor partial sums, order 48, rational geometric tail bound
method.ln: rational square-root bisection (x^(1/2^k), k=112, 2^-320 grid), ln(1+u) bracketed by u-u^2/2 <= ln(1+u) <= u

scope: Independent verification and diagnostic only. The moment sign is the acceptance test; D/E is a diagnostic upper bound on the root of one fixed ledger histogram and is not a realizability or repacking bound. No kappa change; the selected record is unchanged.
